fta_check.population: single-team regular-season player-seasons with Synergy frequency sum >= 0.98 and >= 300 box FGA
fta_check.rule: play-type TS = PTS / (2 x possessions x (1 - turnover share)), CourtLens's definition

definitions.rts: rTS: the player's true shooting minus the league's, TS = PTS / (2 x (FGA + 0.44 x FTA)) over the sealed play-by-play regular season. The same value as the Stats table's rTS% for a whole regular season with no team or date filter.
definitions.play_type_ts: Play-type TS (CourtLens's definition): PTS / (2 x scoring possessions), scoring possessions = possessions x (1 - turnover share). Synergy rows carry no FTA, so this is not box TS and not Databallr's number.
definitions.expected_ts: Expected TS: the sum over play types of the player's share of scoring possessions times the league's play-type TS in the same season.
definitions.difficulty: Playtype Difficulty: league play-type TS minus Expected TS. Positive means a harder than average shot diet. It is in play-type TS units and is added to box-unit rTS.
definitions.league: League references pool every listed offensive row of the same season, weighted by scoring possessions. Using the season's own average is descriptive, not a forecast.

reasons.no_rts: No rTS: the player has no box rows in the sealed play-by-play season.
reasons.small_sample: Fewer than 200 true-shooting attempts (the rTS qualification).
reasons.no_play_types: No Synergy play-type rows for this player-season.
reasons.source_rows_missing: The source is missing at least one whole play-type row: more possessions are missing than the absent types could hold under the source's 10-possession floor.
reasons.low_coverage: Listed play types cover less than 90% of the player's possessions.

summary.credit: zTS, Expected TS and Playtype Difficulty are Databallr's concepts and names (databallr.com); Databallr is the design and method reference for this page. CourtLens's play-type TS definition, coverage rules and numbers are its own and do not reproduce Databallr's. Play-type data: NBA Stats (Synergy Sports) via hoopR / sportsdataverse.
summary.no_interval: zTS is built from season totals, which have no resampling unit below the season, so it is served without an interval. The validation's differences carry 95% bootstrap intervals.
summary.volume_note: Minutes, scoring usage and TS add come from the served impact bundle (the Stats table's source), not from the frozen zTS results. Scoring usage = 100 x TSA / offensive possessions. TS add = 2 x scoring usage x rTS (the Stats table's TS add/100); zTS add = 2 x scoring usage x zTS, both points per 100 offensive possessions. zTS add follows the TS add arithmetic Databallr describes; it is not Databallr's SV/100, whose formula is not published.

unknown_season.reason: No zTS for this season: Synergy play types start in 2015-16, and 2026-27 has no play-type rows or sealed rTS yet.

teams.note: Team playtype difficulty: every listed Synergy offensive row a team's players logged for it, summed, then Expected TS and difficulty exactly as for a player, against the same league references. Rows under the source's 10-possession floor are absent, so team totals run slightly low. Descriptive, not part of the registered test.

role_moves.rule: Players with a served zTS and 1,000+ minutes in each of the 5 seasons ending in 2025-26, ranked by the size of their Role change from the first season to the last; the six largest.
